# LNCrawler

> LNCrawler is a self-hosted light novel reader. It crawls hundreds of sources and
> lets you search, download and read translated Asian light novels and web novels
> (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) in multiple languages.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://lncrawler.monster/): browse featured and recently updated novels.
- [Search novels](https://lncrawler.monster/novels/search): search the catalog by
  title, author, tag, language, status and rating.
- [Add a novel](https://lncrawler.monster/download): download a novel from a
  supported source into the library.

## Indexing

- Sitemap: https://lncrawler.monster/sitemap.xml
- Novel pages: https://lncrawler.monster/novels/{novel-slug}/
- Source (per-language) pages: https://lncrawler.monster/novels/{novel-slug}/{source-slug}/
- Chapter lists: https://lncrawler.monster/novels/{novel-slug}/{source-slug}/chapterlist/
